column1: # Lamakan Desert: Mia's other self takes over after the Manticore falls.

column3: Is that all it had? How\ndisappointing. Beasts\nshould kneel.{end_wait}
Mia... you were smiling.\nWhile it screamed.{end_wait}
And? Know your place,\nGaret. It is not beside me.{end_wait}
...Did I say that? I do\nnot remember drawing\nthe blade.{end_wait}
That voice again. Mia, we\nneed to talk about that\nblade.{end_wait}
